features.name: Adaptive Boot Profile
features.summary: Chooses the best SnowOS startup posture for the active profile.

features.name: Integrity Pulse
features.summary: Publishes trust and integrity state at boot for operator visibility.

features.name: Service Preflight
features.summary: Runs startup checks and surfaces likely failures before they cascade.

features.name: Secure Resume
features.summary: Restores SnowOS state only when integrity and policy checks pass.

features.name: Policy Guard
features.summary: Keeps critical policy assets under continuous trust monitoring.

features.name: Threat Mirror
features.summary: Projects current threat posture into SnowControl at boot and runtime.

features.name: Workspace Resume
features.summary: Restores the last known desktop mood, layout, and task context.

features.name: Context Resume
features.summary: Seeds Nyx with recent state so it wakes up context-aware instead of cold.

features.name: Resource Forecast
features.summary: Predicts startup load and tunes service timing for smoother boot behavior.

features.name: SnowControl Insights
features.summary: Exposes boot profile, feature flags, and platform posture in SnowControl.

features.name: Persona Seed
features.summary: Chooses a startup personality seed for Nyx based on the selected profile.

features.name: Persona Guard
features.summary: Prevents high-risk personas from activating when the trust posture is degraded.

features.name: Error Whisperer
features.summary: Offers fast local explanations when commands or services fail early.

features.name: Build Coach
features.summary: Summarizes likely next fixes after failed builds or unhealthy startup states.

features.name: Plugin Scout
features.summary: Surfaces installable extensions or plugins that fit the active workflow.

features.name: Memory Compass
features.summary: Highlights recently used workspace state so SnowOS can resume with intention.

features.name: Focus Orchestrator
features.summary: Shapes the startup mood and service posture around the user's likely next task.

features.name: Intent Storyline
features.summary: Explains why SnowOS selected a profile, persona, and boot posture in plain language.

features.name: Offline Reasoning Cache
features.summary: Keeps local AI summaries ready even when the wider network path is unavailable.

features.name: Forensic Recap
features.summary: Summarizes degraded boots or policy drift so recovery starts with context.

features.name: Mood Surface
features.summary: Lets the shell presentation shift with platform mood and profile.

features.name: Ambient Scene
features.summary: Drives branded login and desktop ambience from SnowOS state.

features.name: Ritual Boot Sequence
features.summary: Creates a distinct SnowOS startup identity instead of a generic Linux feel.
